stage: All-router anonymous route observations across scanner, PAPER and prospective learning
runtime_requirement: All bot/API/UI/training/research services stay stopped. No operator wallet/key, provider trading call, real order, active model fit/promotion or policy activation. Synthetic HTTP/SDK/temp-journal/dataframe tests are software evidence only.
findings: The actual managed buyer already admitted four V2 routers, while scanner, PAPER entry/reverse exits and prospective research still used Metis V1 quotes. This current source mismatch could exclude opportunities reachable through other managed routers; no causal contribution to the historical no-buy run is asserted.

Several paper/research/export readers required route_count > 0, conflating published Metis topology with the existence of a checked non-Metis quote. Public response fields alone also did not recheck original raw/receipt identity on simulated exits and research fills.

V2 priceImpact is signed percentage points, unlike the legacy nonnegative decimal priceImpactPct ratio. A negative V2 impact is a quoted improvement, not an adverse impact and not realized financial profit.
implemented: Add a pure V2 quote-only contract and one budgeted GET adapter using canonical mint/raw-uint64/slippage identity, ExactIn, maxSupportedTransactionVersion=0 and no taker/payer/receiver/referral. Accept four known routers; forbid transaction or taker material. Bound duplicate-free response parsing to2 MiB; no redirect, POST, signer, wallet, retry or cross-protocol fallback. Explicit managed disable uses existing Metis V1.

Validate whole-route output floor, signed percentage-point impact, optional RFQ expiry and original public/raw fields. Recheck original aware receipt age at most10 seconds without refreshing it. Metis still requires checked topology; other known routers may publish zero physical steps, honestly recorded as zero, never synthetic Metis depth or current/order/fill proof.

Use the shared adapter in actual scanner and PAPER entry/reverse exits, runner and entry-gate research defaults. Keep price/capital/configuration/adverse-impact guards, exact0.1 SOL PAPER, current intent quantity, no-send/uncertain ownership, full actual order/projection/execute/chain reconciliation and uncapped runner objectives independent and unchanged.

Capture only whitelisted public structural quote fields and original metadata with an integrity checksum. Persist typed protocol/router/request/amount/receipt through PAPER entry summaries, exact exit responses, immutable archives, prospective research fills and checked causal net-only export. Historical validation uses the original receipt time and cannot establish current availability or provider authenticity.

Require the new typed proof before accepting non-Metis zero-step evidence. Recheck original entry/fill identities, quantity, receipt chronology, allowed adverse impact and costed exit valuation during research/learning reads. Preserve historical legacy summaries as legacy rather than retroactively certifying them as V2.

Upgrade incomplete synthetic quote fixtures to complete request-bound payloads and aligned clocks while preserving quantity, fee, recovery, no-duplicate and negative-learning assertions. No operator data/models/policies are rewritten.
